title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“终于开始了！”养殖场中，王仙呢喃道。重生数据化前一年，他赌上了所有。虽然知道一年后蓝星会被数据化，却也不怎么完全肯定，毕竟谁知道他是重生，还是精神出了问题。不过现在好了，他终究是赌对了。“打开属性面板。”王仙心中默念道。“请先设置一个昵称。”和刚才一样的声音在脑海之中响起。王仙微微沉默了一下后，道：“仙王。”昵称有的时候真的会害死人，上一世死亡就和他的昵称有关。蓝星数据化后，出现了许多新的种族，其中就有仙族的存在，人家是仙族，你叫‘仙王’，这不是给别人添堵么？虽然因为一些原因，仙族不能光明正大的恁死他，但却在第一次国战之中从背后捅了王仙的刀子，让他死在了战场上。最后被杀死的时候，仙族也说出了一个秘密。‘仙王’与某个传承有关。无论是不是因为传承的原因，王仙依然决定叫‘仙王’，这一次，他要好好的和那些仙族玩玩。昵称设置好后，一道光屏出现在了王仙的面前。姓名：王仙昵称：仙王种族：人族（龙国）职业：个体养殖户年龄：24天赋：【学习（普通）】等级：0经验：0100hp：100mp：80物理攻击力：12魔法攻击力：8暴击：0物理防御：11魔法防御：5力量：12敏捷：11

精神：8体质：10耐力：11技能：无剩余死亡次数：3与其说蓝星被数据化了，不如说是游戏化了，这属性面板完全就是游戏面板。作为重生之人，王仙自然对属性面板一清二楚。五大基础属性很重要，其中力量影响物理攻击，敏捷影响移动速度和攻击速度，精神影响魔法攻击力和魔法值，体质和生命值有关，耐力则和防御有关。至于暴击，需要装备或者称号赋予。和网游有一点不同的就是死亡次数了，网游可以无限复活，但蓝星数据化却有着死亡次数限制，每个人最开始都拥有三次死亡次数。当死亡次数耗尽的时候，那就彻底死亡了。当然了，既然有死亡次数，那也可以获得死亡次数，比如说野外boss首杀，副本首通。除此之外，就是各种活动，以及奇遇了。总之说难也不难，说容易也不容易。天赋，是每个人都有的。王仙这个【学习】天赋还是和前世一样，是最普通的天赋，效果就是在使用技能后，会额外获得一定的熟练度，大约只有百分之一的加成，有点鸡肋。不过，这已经不重要了。王仙看向手中的龙凤玉佩，关于玉佩的信息浮现在眼前。劣质玉佩：毫无价值，但其内部似乎蕴含了什么东西，你或许应该尝试将玉佩打碎。这就是龙凤玉佩的属性。关于这快玉佩，王仙也不知道是哪里来的，只知道一直在家里，似乎是捡来的。上一世王仙被困在那座大城市里，历尽千辛万苦回到老家的时候，已经七十多级了。虽然发现了玉佩的秘密，可终究还是有点晚了。这一世不同，他才零级，正是使用玉佩之中东西的最好时刻。啪！王仙反手一拍，直接将玉佩拍在桌子上，玉佩瞬间碎掉。碎掉后，一股淡淡的清香迎面扑来，玉佩中间的血色则快速的凝到一起，聚成一滴血液。血液漂浮在半空之中，很神奇，也很不科学。只是蓝星都数据化了，谁还管他科学不科学。目光凝望在这滴血液上，它的属性浮现出来。神秘血液：未知存在的血液。很简单的介绍。王仙没有犹豫，直接拿到手中，服了下去。“叮！服用神秘血液，获得新天赋【成长】，并且每十级获得一个新的天赋。”
content_en:
"It finally started!" Wang Xian murmured in the breeding farm.One year before he was reborn as a digital person, he bet everything.Although I know that Blue Star will be digitized in a year, I am not entirely sure. After all, who knows if he will be reborn or if he has a mental problem.But now it's good, he finally made the right bet."Open the properties panel." Wang Xian thought silently in his heart."Please set a nickname first." The same voice as before sounded in my mind.After Wang Xian was silent for a moment, he said: "Immortal King." Sometimes nicknames can really kill people, and his death in the last life was related to his nickname.After Blue Star was digitized, many new races appeared, including the Immortal Race. They are Immortal Races, and you are called the ‘Immortal King’. Isn’t this causing trouble for others?Although due to some reasons, the immortal clan could not kill him openly, they stabbed Wang Xian in the back during the first national war and let him die on the battlefield.When he was finally killed, the immortals also revealed a secret.The ‘Immortal King’ is related to a certain inheritance.Regardless of whether it was due to inheritance or not, Wang Xian still decided to be called the 'Immortal King'. This time, he wanted to have fun with those immortals.After the nickname was set, a light screen appeared in front of Wang Xian.Name: Wang Xian Nickname: Fairy King Race: Human Race (Dragon Kingdom) Occupation: Individual Breeder Age: 24 Talent: [Learning (Normal)] Level: 0 Experience: 0100hp: 100mp: 80 Physical Attack Power: 12 Magic Attack Power: 8 Critical Hit: 0 Physical Defense: 11 Magic Defense: 5 Strength: 12 Agility: 11

Spirit: 8 Physique: 10 Stamina: 11 Skills: None Number of deaths left: 3 Blue Star is not so much digitized as it is gamified. This attribute panel is completely a game panel.As a reborn person, Wang Xian naturally knows the attribute panel clearly.The five basic attributes are very important. Among them, strength affects physical attack, agility affects movement speed and attack speed, spirit affects magic attack power and magic value, physique is related to health value, and endurance is related to defense.As for critical hits, they need to be given equipment or titles.One thing that is different from online games is the number of deaths. Online games can be resurrected infinitely, but Blue Star Digitalization has a limit on the number of deaths. Everyone has three deaths at the beginning.When the number of deaths is exhausted, it will be complete death.Of course, since there are deaths, you can also get the number of deaths, such as the first kill of a wild boss or the first pass of a dungeon.Apart from that, there are various activities and adventures.In short, it is not difficult to say it is difficult, and it is not easy to say it is easy.Talent is something everyone has.Wang Xian's [Learning] talent is still the same as in the previous life. It is the most common talent. The effect is that after using the skill, you will gain a certain amount of additional proficiency. The bonus is only about 1%, which is a bit useless.However, this is no longer important.Wang Xian looked at the dragon and phoenix jade pendant in his hand, and information about the jade pendant appeared in front of his eyes.Low-quality jade pendant: worthless, but it seems to contain something inside. You should probably try to break the jade pendant.This is the attribute of dragon and phoenix jade pendant.Regarding this fast jade pendant, Wang Xian didn't know where it came from. He only knew that it had been at home and he seemed to have picked it up.In the last life, Wang Xian was trapped in that big city and went through all kinds of hardships when he returned to his hometown. He was already over seventy levels.Although I discovered the secret of the jade pendant, it was still a little late.This life is different, he is only at level zero, and it is the best time to use the things in the jade pendant.Snap!Wang Xian slapped the jade pendant directly on the table with his backhand, and the jade pendant shattered instantly.After it was broken into pieces, a faint fragrance rushed towards the face, and the blood in the middle of the jade pendant quickly condensed together into a drop of blood.The blood is floating in the air, which is both magical and unscientific.It's just that Blue Star has been digitized, who cares whether it's scientific or not.Staring at this drop of blood, its attributes emerged.Mysterious blood: blood of unknown existence.Very simple introduction.Wang Xian didn't hesitate, took it directly into his hand and drank it."Ding! Take the mysterious blood and get a new talent [Growth], and get a new talent every ten levels."
